scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run start:all
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:frontend && npm run lint:fix:backend
scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up
scripts.db:health: docker inspect --format={{.State.Health.Status}} fitflow-mysql || echo Container no encontrado
scripts.db:reset: npm run docker:down:volumes && npm run docker:up && npm run db:status
scripts.dev:setup: npm run db:reset && echo === Base lista: inicia el backend con npm run start:backend, el seed corre solo ===
scripts.dev:start: npm run docker:up && npm run start:backend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run docker:up && npm run start:backend
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run docker:clean && echo === Limpieza completa finalizada ===
